title: Mouse Pointer Crosshairs freezes when clicking inside application windows

status.label: Reproduce supplied crosshair freeze
status.detail: Reporter provided exact trigger and recovery steps plus video; maintainer-side tracing is more useful than asking for details again.

next_action.label: Reproduce in responsive applications
next_action.reason: Test whether synchronous mouse-hook work explains the client-area click freeze.

judgment.rationale: The reporter supplied exact steps, video, and desktop-click recovery. Current InclusiveCrosshairs calls UpdateCrosshairsPosition synchronously from the low-level mouse hook, a plausible tracking responsiveness risk, but the specific mechanism is unconfirmed. Open #48442 concerns an unresponsive/loading window and is not established as the same trigger. Current label requests team response, so use maintainer reproduction rather than asking the author to repeat supplied steps.
evidence: The report and video show client-area click trigger and desktop-click recovery on version 0.101.2362.
The latest author update says the issue occurs across several versions.
Current InclusiveCrosshairs::MouseHookProc calls UpdateCrosshairsPosition synchronously for mouse movement.
Open #48442 describes freeze when the underlying window is unresponsive/loading; same trigger is not established.
Four comments and current Needs-Team-Response label; no Needs-Author-Feedback label.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a bounded maintainer-side tracking investigation and reproduce over responsive applications before choosing an implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: Synchronous position/window work in the low-level mouse hook is a plausible responsiveness risk, but current evidence does not prove the cause. Keep the hypothesis yellow and validate with maintainer reproduction.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep crosshair position updates bounded in the low-level mouse hook
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: overlay position work inside MouseHookProc can delay or interfere with tracking when clicking in an application. The report does not establish callback delay, hook loss, or a common cause with #48442.
plan: Reproduce while recording hook callback duration, update delivery, target-window responsiveness, and hook lifetime.
If callback work is blocking, coalesce cursor state and dispatch visual updates rather than performing full position work in the hook.
Add regression coverage for responsive applications and recovery without a desktop click.
verification: Compare the affected application with a simple responsive application while checking input responsiveness.
Verify continuous crosshair tracking and recovery without a desktop click.
Run focused Mouse Utilities tests and build if implementation is warranted.

confidence.rationale: The synchronous hook path is real, but callback behavior during the freeze has not been measured and #48442 has a distinct trigger.

issue_context.summary: Crosshairs freeze after a click in an application client area and resume after a desktop click; exact steps and video were supplied.
known_information: The issue and video describe client-area click and desktop-click recovery on version 0.101.2362.
The reporter says the behavior spans several versions.
Current code updates crosshair position synchronously from a WH_MOUSE_LL callback.
Open #48442 concerns an unresponsive/loading window; trigger differs.
Current labels request team response, and reproducer details are already supplied.
inferences: Synchronous hook work may delay or lose tracking updates, but callback latency or hook removal has not been observed.
Shared recovery with #48442 does not establish duplication because the trigger differs.
issue_context.analysis: Evidence supports a yellow maintainer investigation. Reproduce while checking target responsiveness and hook callback behavior; do not ask for repeated steps or generic diagnostics.
initial_investigation: Read live body, four comments, attached video, labels, assignees, and updatedAt.
Inspected current MouseHookProc and synchronous UpdateCrosshairsPosition path.
Compared #48442; its trigger is an unresponsive/loading window.

actions.label: Approve crosshair tracking investigation
actions.note: Yellow hypothesis for bounded triage, not a detailed implementation design.

actions.label: Reproduce crosshair freeze over responsive windows
actions.note: Use supplied video and steps; do not request duplicated evidence.

reproduce.title: Measure crosshair tracking during client-area clicks
reproduce.version_requirement: Current development build; compare 0.101.2362 if available
prerequisites: Enable Mouse Pointer Crosshairs and retain the supplied video for comparison.
Use a simple responsive application and the originally affected application if identifiable.
steps: Move pointer over the target and confirm the crosshair follows.
Click inside the client area using the reported sequence and observe whether the overlay freezes.
While frozen, test whether the application accepts keyboard input.
Click the desktop and observe whether tracking resumes.
Record hook callback duration and update delivery around the freeze.
reproduce.expected_result: Determine whether the overlay freezes over a responsive window and whether hook work or a lost callback coincides.

upstream_safety.detail: Assessment only; no upstream issue, label, assignment, or comment action was taken.
